llm_summary: The reviewer expresses a mixed sentiment toward the analyzed products, noting that while several items earned "Holy Grail" status for their hydrating and plumping effects, many others failed to deliver promised results. Users particularly value products that soothe inflammation and improve skin texture, though they frequently criticize items that are difficult to spread, cause pilling, or leave an unwanted film on the skin. Ultimately, the decision to repurchase is often deterred by steep price points, ineffective formulations, or concerns regarding long-term skin reactions.
